recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-washed urban portrait featuring a central figure in streetwear, anchored by large, heavily distressed block typography and a secondary clean sans-serif subtitle, set against a textured concrete background with a warm, hazy light source.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sepia color grade unifying the subject and background
Heavy, textured display type overlapping the subject's lower body
Strong verticality in the subject contrasted by horizontal text blocks
High-key light flare in the upper left corner creating atmospheric depth
coreInvariants: Heavily weathered and eroded texture on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure positioned slightly off-center to the right, occupying the middle and upper thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white distressed display text spanning the lower middle of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the light flare in the top left, moves down to the subject's face, then drops to the large white text, and finally to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side and top, balanced by the subject on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep ochre and sepia tones providing the overall mood and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white used for primary typography to ensure legibility against the dark ground.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow/orange light flare in the top left corner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool tones like blue or green
Limit to earth tones and stark white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and a thin modern sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Extra-bold, condensed proportions with flat terminals.
Secondary text: Light weight, wide tracking, uniform stroke width.
Distress: Random erosion, speckles, and 'paint-chip' textures applied to the primary text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary glyphs feature irregular, jagged edges to simulate weathered stencil paint.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast: extra-bold distressed display paired with ultra-light clean subtitle.

preserve: Heavy weight of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, condensed skeleton for the display text.
Offers the clean, geometric contrast needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a person in streetwear standing in a gritty urban alleyway. Apply a heavy sepia and gold color grade with a bright warm lens flare in the top left corner. Add concrete textures and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in a heavy, distressed white sans-serif font across the lower third. Below it, add a subtitle in a thin, clean white sans-serif font with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text heavily textured and eroded?
Is the color palette strictly sepia/gold/white?
Does the subtitle have significantly wider tracking than the title?
Is there a visible light flare in the upper left?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
The specific wording of the text
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text distress looks organic and not like a repeating pattern.
Ensure the sepia tone doesn't wash out the subject's details.
Verify the subtitle is perfectly centered under the main title.
Confirm the lens flare doesn't obscure the subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Sepia Grade + Distressed Heavy Type + Wide-Tracked Subtitle = Gritty Street Aesthetic
